modules.name: Bank Tenant Administration
modules.implemented: Registration, legal entities, database ownership, provisioning/activation, suspension and audited changes
modules.boundary: Actual first-bank lifecycle and operator-prepared production activation require acceptance; no bank configuration is assumed

modules.name: Identity, Staff & Sessions
modules.implemented: Registered staff, MFA enforcement, disable/revoke, session expiry and history
modules.boundary: Real identity-provider sign-in and MFA recovery must be exercised; expired development exceptions are not functioning production MFA

modules.name: Bank/Branch Roles & Authority
modules.implemented: Bank/branch restrictions, operational roles, lending grants, per-currency/operation authority and revoke-before-post checks
modules.boundary: Lending/cash/payment scopes exist; finer treasury, compliance and general administration roles remain. Actual bank assignments/caps are not configured by tests

modules.name: Approval Inbox
modules.implemented: Maker/checker decisions, reject/cancel, stale-version rejection, immutable events and retry protection
modules.boundary: Accept every operation/role combination and pending-request behaviour after staff/policy changes; scope model is not uniform across all modules

modules.name: Reference Data & Calendars
modules.implemented: Currency/language settings, precision, rounding, holidays, weekends and forward business dates
modules.boundary: Actual country/bank calendars and conventions require approval; complete locale content is F33

modules.name: Chart of Accounts
modules.implemented: Bank hierarchy, categories, posting definitions, uniqueness and independent approval
modules.boundary: Bank-specific mappings and accounting policy validation remain

modules.name: Ledger Accounts
modules.implemented: Dedicated bank storage, approved ledger definitions, ownership checks and recoverable delivery
modules.boundary: Independently reconcile account/category mappings and protection of dedicated customer/cash/FX ledgers

modules.name: Journals & General Reversals
modules.implemented: Balanced single-currency journals, immutable lines, full reversal, date checks and retry receipts
modules.boundary: Not a universal reversal API: product-specific journals require their own controls. Prior-period correction policy is not supplied

modules.name: Accounting Reports
modules.implemented: Trial balance, ledger statement, turnover reconciliation and CSV
modules.boundary: Operational/regulatory/consolidated translated reports are not complete; bank chart/report presentation remains to be accepted

modules.name: Business Day Close
modules.implemented: Readiness checks, independent close, posting locks, next-working-day advancement and recovery
modules.boundary: Controlled reopening, branch-specific closing and month/year-end procedures remain
modules.source: P0 core close; P1 extensions; E06

modules.name: Product Factory
modules.implemented: Savings/current products, minimums, currency, liability mapping, immutable revisions and activation
modules.boundary: General eligibility/overdraft rules, full term/loan catalogues and controlled existing-account terms migration remain; separate servicing policies already exist

modules.name: Individual Customer Onboarding
modules.implemented: Profiles, manual document references, exact duplicate checks, approval and bank delivery
modules.boundary: Corporate/beneficial-owner/joint/guardian models, automated document verification and general periodic review are not complete; references are not document storage

modules.name: Compliance Cases
modules.implemented: Manual evidence, independent review, restrictions and expiry/current-profile checks
modules.boundary: Automated sanctions/PEP/transaction monitoring, mandatory universal review, scoped investigators, assignment/SLA and regulatory reports remain

modules.name: Deposit Account Lifecycle
modules.implemented: Opening with pinned terms, approval, eligibility, activation through funding, freeze and bounded closure
modules.boundary: Zero-balance closure now supported with independent approval and obligation checks. Positive-balance payout, final interest/fee/tax settlement and closure with contract/payment history remain missing

modules.name: Funding & Customer Balances
modules.implemented: Approved funding, exact subledger/GL integration, balances and safe retry
modules.boundary: Accept genuine funding-evidence controls and bank mappings; external receipt verification is not automatic

modules.name: Holds, Withdrawals, Transfers & Reversals
modules.implemented: Holds/releases, recorded withdrawals, same-bank/entity/currency transfers and full supported reversals
modules.boundary: Not cross-bank clearing; broader value-date/partial corrections and product-specific operations need explicit scope
modules.source: P0 supported paths; P1 extensions; E08

modules.name: Branch & Staff Transaction Limits
modules.implemented: Required bank policies plus scoped branch/staff caps and pending-usage controls
modules.boundary: Bank must define currencies/operations/caps and treatment of each reversal; no approved financial limits are inferred

modules.name: Teller & Cash
modules.implemented: Vault/till custody, cash deposits/withdrawals, counts, exceptions, approved adjustments, reversals and interbranch transit
modules.boundary: Carrier custody, emergency reassignment and broader shipment investigation/write-off workflows remain; unresolved transit blocks day close
modules.source: P0 current cash flows; P1 extensions; E09

modules.name: Denominations & Receipts
modules.implemented: Approved catalogue, opening stock, quantity checks, movement/reversal tracking and printable numbered receipts
modules.boundary: Denomination exchange/reclassification, extended receipt variants and bank-specific receipt requirements remain

modules.name: Interest, Fees & Taxes
modules.implemented: Actual/360 or fixed Actual/365, closing-balance interest, daily capitalization, fixed business-day fee, explicit taxes and fractional carry
modules.boundary: Tiered/value-date/backdated calculations, deferred capitalization, exemptions, deposit-fee waivers and servicing correction remain; current rules are not universal product rules

modules.name: Daily Financial Processing
modules.implemented: Preview, independent batch approval, atomic posting, deterministic receipts, statement integration and date sealing
modules.boundary: **Hard limit: 1,000 funded nonclosed accounts/run; 31 days to next working day.** Frozen/ineligible accounts can block the whole batch. No chunking or automatic run creation/approval

modules.name: Customer Statements & Notifications
modules.implemented: Running balances, date filtering and portal/backend CSV; in-app operational alerts in selected modules
modules.boundary: CSV export capped at **10,000 entries**; PDF, customer delivery preferences, email/SMS and delivery history remain
modules.source: P1 exports/required notices; P2 optional channels; E08, E14

modules.name: M-Pesa Payouts
modules.implemented: Kenya B2C sandbox adapter, approval/debit, one dispatch, status inquiry and callback observations
modules.boundary: **Production-profile dispatch disabled in code.** Actual contracted sandbox acceptance, live adapter/certification, collections and other rails remain

modules.name: Statement Import & Reconciliation
modules.implemented: Normalized CSV, immutable evidence, duplicate checks, wallet/GL matching, fees, adjustments and independent closure
modules.boundary: Native provider format not accepted against a real sample; split/net settlement, suspense and automated acquisition remain

modules.name: Payment Exceptions & Returns
modules.implemented: Scoped investigations, approved dated carry, overdue indicators and evidence-backed full returns
modules.boundary: Partial returns, remote reversal initiation, outbound escalation and larger lookup/search workflows remain

modules.name: FX Rates & Conversion
modules.implemented: Independently approved rate books, supported own-customer conversion, atomic currency legs and full reversal
modules.boundary: Automated feeds, two-foreign-currency cross trades and broader market workflows remain

modules.name: FX Valuation & P&L
modules.implemented: Conversion-book closing rates, weighted-average realized/unrealized P&L, long/short limits and closing gates
modules.boundary: Not full-bank monetary-item translation. Book policy/limit amendments, valuation correction, period P&L transfer and scoped treasury access remain

modules.name: Term Deposits & Servicing
modules.implemented: Fixed-rate opening/accrual, withholding, maturity payout, renewal, full early closure and in-app maturity alerts
modules.boundary: Partial closure, standing renewal, richer penalty/repricing policy, full catalogue and customer notifications remain

modules.name: Contract Corrections
modules.implemented: Original-linked eligible current-open-day opening/disbursement, accrual and repayment reversal; dependent-event and duplicate controls
modules.boundary: Prior-day/value-date corrections and redemption/renewal/early-closure reversals are outside current scope
modules.source: P0 supported correction paths; P1 extensions; E11

modules.name: Loan Applications & Credit Review
modules.implemented: Immutable dossier, manually evidenced affordability/security, independent policy/review and disbursement conditions
modules.boundary: Editable draft workflow, bureau/group exposure, verified document storage, legal security perfection/release and richer committee routing remain

modules.name: Loan Servicing & Impairment
modules.implemented: Fixed-rate equal-principal schedules, interest-first repayment, bounded restructure, manually assessed allowance and full covered write-off
modules.boundary: Moratoria/non-accrual, interest capitalization, partial write-off, automated ECL/IFRS 9 and post-write-off recovery remain; stage-only allowance changes unsupported

modules.name: Arrears & Collections
modules.implemented: Posted principal/interest/fee ageing, assignments, promises, escalation history and approved fee assessment/payment/waiver
modules.boundary: Fee-payment reversal/taxation, automatic penalty policies, borrower notices, legal recovery and scalable snapshots remain; replay rejects over **10,000 completed events/contract**

modules.name: Multitenancy, Currency & Language Coverage
modules.implemented: Dedicated bank routing, decimal money, configurable currencies and some English/French/Swahili labels
modules.boundary: Currency configuration is not full FX accounting; several newer screens remain English. Complete translated journeys, statements/receipts and locale review are unaccepted
modules.source: P0 isolation/money; P1 required languages; E02, E04, E14

modules.name: Deployment, Backup & Recovery
modules.implemented: Preflight, migration/runtime separation, encrypted coordinated backup/restore, queue monitoring and operating runbook
modules.boundary: Actual server/HTTPS/MFA, scheduled/off-host backups, real identity restoration, alert delivery and failover remain. Local cold-backup tooling does not supply PITR
modules.source: P0 release gate, distinct from product functionality; E15

cases.title: Register and provision an isolated bank
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Register a fictional bank with an approved binding. Approve applicable lifecycle actions, provision/activate, then suspend and resume.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: One bank owns its dedicated database. State changes and actors are audited. Suspended bank rejects new financial work.

cases.title: Duplicate or wrong-owner bank registration
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Replay same key/payload; change payload on same key; reuse bank code or binding; try to activate a database owned by another bank.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Replay returns the original result. Conflicts and wrong ownership reject with no extra bank, activation or orphaned financial record.

cases.title: MFA, sessions and staff lifecycle
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Register maker and checker. Sign in with real test MFA. Revoke own session, revoke staff sessions as authorized and disable a staff member.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Valid users enter only their permitted workspace. Expired/revoked sessions and disabled users lose access. No development bypass is treated as MFA acceptance.

cases.title: Expired, forged and revoked identity
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Use missing/expired/wrong-issuer tokens, invalid MFA proof and revoked session. Try revoking another person's session through self-service.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Requests fail without data leakage or mutation. Bootstrap cannot reactivate deliberately disabled staff. Correct correlation IDs remain in safe logs.

cases.title: Bank and branch grants
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Grant credit, collections and cash roles only in KE_A branch 1. Execute permitted read and operational actions using each real identity.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Only explicitly granted operations succeed. Limits and bank/branch scope match the approved test policy. Read-only auditors cannot mutate data.

cases.title: Cross-scope privilege escalation
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Use KE_A branch-1 staff to read/export/approve/post KE_B or branch-2 data. Change bank IDs in URLs and payloads; revoke membership before first posting.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: No unauthorized records or effects. Immediate revocation is enforced for implemented role scopes. Missing fine-grained administration roles remain a documented gap.

cases.title: Independent approval decisions
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Submit distinct changes for approve, reject and cancel. Decide with a different authorized user and inspect the queue and history.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Exactly one decision applies. Rejected/cancelled requests have no financial effect. Original maker, reviewer, reason and decision remain visible.

cases.title: Self-approval, stale state and concurrent decision
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Attempt self-approval and unauthorized review. Change the target before review. Submit two simultaneous independent decisions.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Self/unauthorized/stale decisions reject. Concurrent decisions produce one applied result and consistent event history, not duplicate side effects.

cases.title: Currency, calendar and language settings
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve configured currency precision, rounding, holidays, weekends and language preferences. Preview rounding and next working day.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Configuration matches the approved fixture. Next date skips configured non-working days. User language preference does not change another user's setting.

cases.title: Invalid reference configuration
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Submit invalid currency precision, unsupported rounding, conflicting holiday input and a backward business date. Disable a required functional currency.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Invalid configurations reject without partial settings changes. Historical money is not silently rounded or relabelled.

cases.title: Chart hierarchy and mapping
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve asset, liability, income and expense groups and posting leaves. View the hierarchy and use approved leaves in ledgers.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Correct parent/category relationships and bank ownership persist. Only posting leaves with suitable categories are used by financial products.

cases.title: Invalid chart structure
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Attempt duplicate code, cycle, incompatible parent/category, posting into a group and changes to protected mappings.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Invalid proposals reject or become explicitly stale. No cross-bank parent or unusable financial mapping is applied.

cases.title: Ledger delivery and readback
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve matching asset and customer-liability ledgers in KE_A and different ledgers in KE_B. Deliver and read back both.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Each ledger exists only in its intended bank database. Definition, version and approved chart/entity/currency agree with the control registry.

cases.title: Wrong ledger ownership or protected-ledger misuse
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Change target-bank binding, use a foreign entity/currency and attempt generic postings to dedicated customer/cash/FX ledgers.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Wrong route and protected-ledger misuse reject. Bank-side and control-side definitions remain consistent.

cases.title: Balanced journal and full reversal
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Post a fictional KES 100 debit/credit journal, independently approve and deliver. Submit an eligible full reversal and deliver it.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Each journal balances by currency/entity. Original stays immutable. Reversal links to it and restores net balances exactly once.

cases.title: Unbalanced and closed-day journal
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Submit unmatched debit/credit, excessive currency precision, inactive/foreign ledger, closed-date and duplicate reversal variants.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Each invalid journal has zero financial effect. Valid original and reversal remain immutable; no rounding adjustment is invented.

cases.title: Reports tied to posted entries
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Post known journals on two business dates. Export trial balance and ledger statements for each date range and compare with the independent worksheet.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Posted debits, credits, opening/closing balances and CSV totals agree exactly. Pending journals are not presented as posted movements.

cases.title: Turnover drift with matching net balance
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. In a disposable fixture only, introduce an independently recorded turnover mismatch with unchanged net balance, then run reconciliation.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Reconciliation detects gross debit/credit drift, not merely net agreement. Mark the fixture contaminated and rebuild it after the test.

cases.title: Business-day close
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Prepare a reconciled date with required batches and cash closures complete. Preview, independently approve close, deliver and retry.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: The next configured business day is reached once. Closed-day ordinary postings fail. Close totals and event history remain immutable.

cases.title: Close with pending work and mismatches
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Attempt close while a journal/delivery, till, cash transit, servicing obligation or reconciliation mismatch is unresolved.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Date stays unchanged and concrete blockers are returned. Resolving one blocker does not conceal another. Ordinary closed-day work stays blocked.

cases.title: Product revisions pinned at opening
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve a savings product revision 1, open an account, then approve revision 2 and open another account.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Each account retains its agreed revision, currency, minimums and liability mapping. Revision 2 does not silently alter the first account.

cases.title: Invalid or inactive product
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Use inactive product, wrong currency/category, invalid minimums and stale revision. Revise while an opening awaits approval.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Invalid/stale opening rejects. Existing accounts retain agreed terms and are not migrated by product edit.

cases.title: Individual customer onboarding
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Submit a fictional individual with manual document references. Independently approve, deliver to its bank and open an eligible account.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Only the approved delivered profile becomes usable. Profile/audit history is preserved. Document references are not represented as verified document storage.

cases.title: Duplicate and ineligible customer
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Use an existing exact document reference; reject an onboarding request; change profile/evidence before account approval.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: No unauthorized duplicate activation or stale eligible profile. Rejected/pending customers cannot open funded accounts.

cases.title: Compliance restriction and clearance
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Open a manual restriction on a customer. Attempt a supported financial operation. Obtain independent current-evidence clearance and retry.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Restriction blocks the covered operation. Valid clearance restores eligibility. Decision and evidence references are retained without claiming automated screening.

cases.title: Stale or self-cleared compliance case
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Attempt self-clearance, expired review, old-profile evidence and financial posting after a fresh restriction.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Independent current evidence is required; covered work remains blocked. Generic AML/sanctions automation is not claimed.

cases.title: Deposit account state lifecycle
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Open an account awaiting funding, fund it, freeze it, reactivate it and inspect pinned terms and history. Run closure separately with the closure fixture.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Activation requires delivered funding. Freeze blocks relevant transactions. Approved state changes preserve identity, currency and product terms.

cases.title: Invalid account structure and state
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Try changing customer, product revision, currency or entity after opening; activate without funding; reopen CLOSED.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Structure changes and invalid states reject. Account identity and financial history remain intact.

cases.title: Received-deposit funding
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Using fixture D1, submit 1,000 KES of verified fictional received funds, independently approve and deliver.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Posted customer balance increases by 1,000. Debit receiving asset 1,000 and credit customer liability 1,000. Pending approval does not increase posted balance.

cases.title: Duplicate funding and lost acknowledgement
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Replay approved funding and retry after bank commit but control acknowledgement loss. Inject failure before receipt commit.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: One credit and receipt only. Failed bank transaction leaves no partial balance/journal; pending status remains visible until recovery.

cases.title: Holds, transfers and withdrawal corrections
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Using D1, hold/release 200 on A, transfer 250 from A to B, withdraw 100 from B and reverse that withdrawal.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Hold changes available balance only. Final balances A=750 and B=250. Customer entries and GL agree; reversal preserves the original withdrawal.

cases.title: Insufficient, held and minimum funds
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Try to withdraw/transfer held funds, exceed available balance, violate minimum balance, release twice and reverse an invalid amount.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Rejected operations have no effect. Release cannot create money; valid corrections link to original amounts and records.

cases.title: Bank, branch and staff limits
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve explicit test limits. Execute at cap minus one currency unit, at cap and one unit above. Include pending daily usage and a second currency.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Below/at-cap allowed only with proper authority; over-cap rejected. Pending exposure and retries are counted correctly. Currency authority is not inferred through FX.

cases.title: Concurrent limit exhaustion
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Submit competing operations that together exceed the same daily/branch/staff cap; replay one and revoke authority before delivery.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Total accepted exposure never exceeds applicable authority. Retries do not consume twice. Unsupported override is rejected.

cases.title: Teller and interbranch cash
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Open counted custody, move vault-to-till cash, perform deposit/withdrawal, send interbranch cash and receive or return it through independent decisions.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Custodian scope, physical counts, cash GL and in-transit records agree. Cash cannot disappear in transit. Unresolved transit blocks relevant close.

cases.title: Wrong custodian and unresolved cash difference
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Attempt another teller's custody, insufficient till cash, self-approved adjustment and close with unexplained count difference.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Unauthorized movements reject. No silent write-off or fictitious balancing entry; unresolved differences remain visible.

cases.title: Denomination inventory and receipts
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
2. Approve test denominations and opening stock. Perform counted cash movements, reverse one and print/reprint its receipt.
3. Compare all effects with the expected results; attach IDs and evidence.
cases.expected: Quantity times denomination equals transaction total. Inventory remains nonnegative. Reversal restores valid stock and original receipt number/history remains traceable.

cases.title: Unavailable denominations and duplicate reversal
cases.preconditions: Isolated baseline B0; registered maker and independent checker with the required implemented role; approved test-only mappings/policies. Follow the named fixture where specified.
cases.steps:
1. Confirm preconditions and capture baseline.
